## Paste block 1 - CNC quote request (option A)

Please quote 3 pcs of each of two small parts, aluminium 7075-T6 (6061-T6 as alternative), as-machined, edges broken 0.2-0.3, no anodising on the pin/hub/pegs. STEP files attached: s2wrist_j3_shaft_flange.step and s2wrist_j3_horn_plate_al.step. Critical dimensions (everything else ISO 2768-m):

- **J3 shaft-flange (CNC)** (qty 3): File s2wrist_j3_shaft_flange.step. Material 7075-T6 (6061-T6 acceptable fallback: payload limit 1.0 kg bottles, see README). Turn + mill. Overall 46 x 46 x 25 mm: flange 46 x 46 x 3.0 (+-0.1), R6 corners; hub D14.0 (+-0.1) x 1.6; pin D11.95 (+0.00/-0.02) from z 67.1 to 85.5, Ra <= 1.6 um; 2 pegs D3.0 (+0.00/-0.01) x 2.0 at (+-4.0, 0) +-0.05 on the pin top; 4 x D3.4 (+0.1/0) through on a 36 x 36 square (+-0.05); central bore D3.4 through with a 90 deg countersink D6.4 on the flange underside (DIN 7991 M3 flat head flush); R1.0 at the hub/flange fillet. Flange underside flat 0.05, pin perpendicular to it 0.03, pin/hub coaxial 0.03. Break all edges 0.2-0.3. NO anodise / hard coat on the pin, hub or pegs (mask them) - bare, bead-blast or chromate conversion only. ISO 2768-m elsewhere.

- **J3 horn plate (CNC)** (qty 3): File s2wrist_j3_horn_plate_al.step. Material 7075-T6 (or 6061-T6). Disc D24.0 (+0/-0.1) x 3.5 (+-0.05). From the bottom face: 4 x 90 deg countersink D6.2 x 1.6 for DIN 7991 M3 flat head on a 10 x 10 square (+-0.05) with D3.4 through; 2 x D3.1 (+0.05/0) x 2.2 deep at (+-4.0, 0) +-0.05 (peg holes); central M3 x 0.5 threaded hole (tap drill D2.5 x 3.0 deep, thread 2.5 deep). Break edges 0.2. Same finish note as A1.

Inspection report requested for: pin D11.95 (+0/-0.02), flange underside flatness 0.05, pin perpendicularity 0.03, hole positions.

## Paste block 2 - metal supplier / hardware shop (option B)

- **steel rod D12 (cold-drawn, drillable)** (to order: 5): D12 mm round bar, UNHARDENED steel: AISI/SAE 1018 or 1045, 12L14, or silver steel (annealed). h9 or better (11.957-12.000 mm). NOT a hardened chrome linear shaft (cannot be drilled / tapped) and not A2 stainless (work hardens). Cut to 23.0 - t_plate mm (20.00 mm for a 3.00 mm plate; 19.83 mm for 1/8 in = 3.175 mm plate), both end faces faced square (<= 0.05 mm over D12), 0.3 x 45 deg chamfers, no burrs. Order 150 mm and cut 5-6 pieces (2 kits + spares).

- **aluminium plate 3 mm (flat parts)** (to order: 6): 6061-T6 (or 5052-H32) sheet/plate, 3.0 mm (1/8 in = 3.175 mm is fine): NOT 1100/3003 or unknown 'aluminium sheet'. Cut from the DXF files s2wrist_nc_flange_plate.dxf (46 x 46, R6, 4 x D3.4 on 36 x 36, 3 x D3.0 on r 3.5) and s2wrist_nc_horn_plate.dxf (D24, 4 x D3.4 on 10 x 10, 2 x D3.2 (dowel holes, +0.1/0) at +-4,0 (if the plate does not seat over both dowels, open them by hand with a D3.2 drill, never larger)), 1:1, laser / waterjet / CNC router, tolerance +-0.1. Countersink afterwards with a 90 deg bit: D5.0 on the underside of the 3 holes on r 3.5 of the flange plate (head flush), D6.2 on the underside of the 4 holes on 10 x 10 of the horn plate. Deburr.

- **screws M2.5 x 8 DIN 7991 (flat head, steel 8.8)** (to order: 20): M2.5 x 8 countersunk flat head, DIN 7991 / ISO 10642, steel 8.8 (zinc / black oxide). NOT A2-70, NOT brass. 3 per arm. Fit with Loctite 243 or similar medium threadlocker.

- **retaining compound (Loctite 638 or 648)** (to order: 1): Loctite 638 (high strength, slip-fit retaining compound, gap fill 0.15-0.25 mm) 10 mL (or 50 mL); used on the rod/bearing bores, rod top face + dowels. Plus a small bottle of medium threadlocker (Loctite 243).
